question.text: Kiran Healthcare Pvt Ltd's AIR covers a maternal-health programme. Per the Box 7.2 Health indicators, which number belongs in the CLINICAL SERVICES indicator set rather than the COMMUNITY SERVICES set?

answer.text: Numbers screened and diagnosed for Non-Communicable Diseases (NCDs)
Number of patients treated — OPD, IPD, Operated (Major, Minor, Intermediate)

explanation.text: The Logic: Box 7.2 splits Health indicators into (A) Clinical Services and (B) Community Services. 'Number of patients treated — OPD/IPD/Operated' is item I under Clinical. Immunisation, Malaria slide rate and NCD screening are under Community Services. The Trap: All four options are real Box 7.2 indicators, but only patients-treated sits under Clinical. This tests careful reading of the taxonomy rather than memorisation of a single list. Cross-Exam Context: SAS-200 (healthcare) standards in Topic 6 pick up this Clinical/Community split explicitly. Assessor's Pro-Tip: When scoping a healthcare SIA engagement, ask upfront whether the SE runs clinical OR community OR both, and then pick the matching Box 7.2 sub-list. A mixed programme often has indicators that should appear in both tables — cross-reference carefully.
